During the darkness step of the shadow phase, each hero that is in darkness suffers an amount of fear indicated by the app.
(Typically 2 fear, Spirit negates.)

space_traits.name: Difficult Ground
space_traits.text: When a hero moves into a space with difficult ground, that hero can discard one prepared card. If they do not discard a card, they cannot move out of that space this turn.

space_traits.name: Fortified
space_traits.text:
A hero cannot move out of a fortified space if there are more enemy figures than hero figures in that space, including the hero who is moving.
An enemy group cannot move out of a fortified space if there are more hero figures than enemy figures in that space, including the enemy group that is moving.

modifiers.name: Pierce
modifiers.text: This attack ignores the enemy’s armor.

modifiers.name: Smite
modifiers.text: This attack ignores the enemy’s sorcery.

modifiers.name: Sunder
modifiers.text: This attack permanently reduces the enemy’s armor by one (before hits are applied).

modifiers.name: Cleave
modifiers.text: Each enemy in the group suffers the full number of hits.

modifiers.name: Lethal
modifiers.text: If this attack reduces the enemy’s current health by at least half, the enemy is defeated.

modifiers.name: Stun
modifiers.text: This attack exhausts the enemy group. If the group is elite, it also cannot counterattack this attack.

keywords.name: Scout X
keywords.text: When an effect instructs you to “Scout X,” reveal X cards from the top of your skill deck. You may prepare one of those cards (place it faceup under your hero card). Then, place each of the remaining revealed cards on the top or bottom of your skill deck in any order.

keywords.name: Strike X
keywords.text: During your attack test, you may discard a card that has the “Strike X” keyword to add X hits to the attack.

keywords.name: Guard X
keywords.text: When you or a hero in your space would suffer damage or fear, you may discard a card that has the “Guard X” keyword to prevent any combination of X damage and fear.

keywords.name: Sprint X
keywords.text: During your turn, you can discard a card that has the “Sprint X” keyword to move X additional spaces. You can perform actions between each movement.

keywords.name: Rest X
keywords.text: At the end of your turn, you can discard a card that has the “Rest X” keyword to discard any combination of X of your facedown damage or fear cards

keywords.name: Hide X
keywords.text: After performing a test, you can discard a card that has the “Hide” keyword to gain a “Hidden” boon card.
